routes.question: Can the binomial transport identity and a lower bound for the large-prime part force a common prime?
premises: V_i(n) is the divisor of A supported on primes >= i
routes.method: Use A*binom(n-i,j-i)=B*binom(j,i), then compare V_i(n) with binom(j,i)
routes.next_test: seek a stronger arithmetic lower bound for V_i(n) than the universal carry-count bound

routes.question: Can the strong-form exceptional families be deformed so that the endpoint prime p=i also disappears?

evidence: For fixed (i,j), the explicit size bound makes n finite
